SELECT uiv.application_user_id , NVL(umv.full_name_local,umv.english_full_name) AS employee_name , uiv.log_seq_no , uiv.inquiry_condition_value , uiv.column_content , TO_CHAR(uiv.effective_to_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS effective_to_date FROM LGCOM_USER_INPUT_VALUE_LOG_N uiv , LGCOM_USER_M_V umv WHERE uiv.effective_to_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND uiv.application_user_id = umv.application_user_id
AND uiv.application_user_id IN
#{userIds[${index}]}
AND UPPER(uiv.inquiry_condition_value) LIKE UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND UPPER(uiv.column_content) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyvalue}) || '%'
ORDER BY uiv.application_user_id, uiv.inquiry_condition_value, uiv.column_content
